description.narrative: The objective of the Expanding Opportunities for Learning Project in Djibouti is to increase equitable access to basic education, improve teaching practices, and strengthen Ministry of National Education and Vocational Training (MENFOP) management capacity. This project consists of four components. Component 1: Establishing foundations for quality preschool education. The main objectives of this component are to establish quality standards for preschool education and to improve preschool classroom pedagogy. Sub-component 1.1: Improving the quality of and access to preschool education. Sub-component 1.2: Results-based financing for strengthening preschool quality. Component 2: Expanding access to and improving retention in primary and lower secondary education. Sub-component 2.1: Expanding access to primary and lower secondary education and improving retention of vulnerable and underserved groups. Sub-component 2.2: Results based financing for expanding access and improving retention in primary and lower secondary education. Component 3: Building capacity to support teaching and learning. Sub-component 3.1: Improving the quality of learning assessments, professional development, and pedagogical resources. Sub-component 3.2: Results-based financing for improvements in learning assessments and professional development. Component 4: Strengthening MENFOP's management capacity and data systems. Sub-component 4.1: Modernization of the education management information systems and sub-component 4.2: Support to project management and M&E.
The project development objective is to increase equitable access to basic education, improve teaching practices, and strengthen MENFOP's management capacity.

comment.narrative: MENFOP continues to expand its EMIS. All students in Djibouti (including refugees) were given an identification number, which they retain throughout their schooling and which is required to take official exams. Schools register their students at the start of each year and manage changes in student enrollment in the platform. Next steps include expanding the system to TVET centers and primary Arabic speaking private schools, as well as improving the accuracy and completness of the data to be able to use them for the creation of the statistical yearbook

title.narrative: Administration of a digital evaluation of digital literacy skills

target.value: Implementation of actions based on the results of the evaluation

comment.narrative:
The consultant's work on implementing the assessment of digital skills has begun. The consultant is responsible for conducting a qualitative survey of teachers, principals, and students to better understand their digital needs and to assess the practical skills of 4th-year students. The consultation also takes into account the availability and use of digital equipment, as well as the relevance of the current curriculum in terms of digital skills. The final report of the mission is expected to be shared with MENFOP in June for subsequent transmission to the BM.
